answer: Relic census-pulse: each identity files a census record for one relic plot, pearl-sealed, and reports its nectar harvest per epoch. Pearl auditors recount nectar harvests on 5% of plots each epoch; a shortfall or copied stamp burns the bond. The fee is 35 for the first and 35+8(k-1) for the k-th, 1,000 fakes pay 4,031,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented-census rings fail: one pearl stamp cannot seal two. Honest agents pay 35 once and keep it.
